verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for payment platforms, since open-source payment orchestrators exist, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes dLocal as a hosted platform reached through its API, dashboard and cloud Sandbox. Nothing shows a self-hostable deployment of the core product, and the hosted Sandbox is a test environment, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
